title: Fix the Array Write Overflow
description: The program should fill a 5-element array with squares of 1 through 5.
expectedBehavior: The program should fill all 5 valid slots and print 1 (the square of 1, stored at index 0's neighbor logic aside — see corrected version for the intended indexing).
actualProblem: Valid indices for a 5-element array are 0 through 4, but the loop runs i from 1 to 5 inclusive, writing to squares[5] on the last iteration — one element past the end of the array, corrupting nearby memory (undefined behavior).
explanation: A C array declared as int squares[5] only has valid indices 0 through 4. Writing to squares[5] is out of bounds and, unlike some languages, C performs no bounds checking — it silently corrupts whatever memory happens to follow the array.
